register.name: Companies House (United Kingdom)
register.access: public web pages, no API key (the free REST API needs a key the owner has not created yet)

archive.line_format: sha256 time kind (kind replaces the URL, which would identify a company)

method: Only companies the private research record names with a legal form (Limited, Ltd, PLC, LLP) are looked up. Brand names are not guessed into companies.

A company counts as matched only when exactly one company on Companies House has the same name after normalising punctuation and Limited/Ltd. Two or more candidates are reported as ambiguous and not used.

For each matched company we read its current directors, then each director's list of appointments (up to 105 per director), then the company page of every dissolved or insolvent company in that list for its dates.
"Dissolved within 2 years" means the company page shows a dissolution date at most 730 days after incorporation.

Dissolution is common and lawful, for example when a single-project company is closed after completion. It is a question to ask, not a finding. Liquidation, administration and receivership are insolvency procedures.
Nothing personal is published: no names, company numbers, dates of birth or addresses. Directors are labelled A, B, C within each project only.

not_covered.reason: No official register with free, open officer data was found that works without an account, captcha or paid API. OpenCorporates needs an API key and its free tier is for public-benefit projects only, so it is not used.
ABN Lookup is open but lists no directors; ASIC officer extracts are paid.
CRO officer data is behind a paid extract.
